d: Hierarchical data structure with at most two children per node.

p: Binary Trees are solved using Depth First Search (DFS/Recursion) or Breadth First Search (BFS/Queue). DFS is preferred for tree properties (depth, inversion, paths) while BFS is used for level-order problems.
1. Identify the base case (usually `if not node: return`).
2. Recursively call left child and right child.
3. Return the combined result to the parent.

def maxDepth(root):
  if not root:
    return 0
  
  left_depth = maxDepth(root.left)
  right_depth = maxDepth(root.right)
  
  return 1 + max(left_depth, right_depth)
Time: O(N) visits every node. Space: O(H) where H is the height of the tree (call stack).
